description_en: Describes the syntax and examples for the SearchFace operation in the facebody category
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸人体（facebody）类目下的人脸搜索SearchFace的语法及示例
name: SearchFace

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database.

Specify either DbName or DbNames. If both parameters are specified, DbNames takes precedence over DbName
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称。

DbName与DbNames二选一，如果同时配置了两个参数，DbNames优先级高于DbName
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored on your local machine or in OSS buckets outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html. The URL can be up to 1,024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。URL长度不超过1024个字符
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of face search results to return for a single face. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单个人脸列表中搜索人脸结果数量限制，取值范围1~100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The list of database names, separated by commas (,). This parameter allows cross-database queries and supports up to 10 databases.
Specify either DbName or DbNames. If both parameters are specified, DbNames takes precedence over DbName
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称列表，以英文逗号（,）分割，可以实现跨库查询，最大支持10个数据库。
DbName与DbNames二选一，如果同时配置了两个参数，DbNames优先级高于DbName
parameters.name: db_names

parameters.help_en: The quality score threshold. The system analyzes the quality of the face image. If the obtained quality score is less than this threshold, the face image quality does not meet the requirements and the comparison fails. Valid values: [0.0, 100.0]. A value of 0.0 or an empty value indicates that the quality score check is skipped
parameters.help_zh: 质量分阈值。对人脸图片进行质量分析判断，得到的质量分小于该阈值则表示人脸图片质量不符合要求，比对失败。取值范围[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做质量分判断逻辑
parameters.name: quality_score_threshold

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of faces in the input image to search and compare. This parameter controls the number of face sample lists. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 对输入图像中多少个人脸进行检索比对，控制人脸样本列表个数，取值范围1~10，默认为5
parameters.name: max_face_num

MatchList.description_en: The list of matched results. If the input image contains multiple faces, multiple data entries are returned
MatchList.description_zh: 匹配的结果列表，如果输入图像中多个人脸，则这里会返回多个数据

FaceItems.description_en: The list of matched face data

Confidence.description_en: The converted confidence score. Valid values: 0.0 to 100.0. A higher value indicates a higher similarity. The three recommended reference thresholds are 60.48, 67.87, and 72.62, which correspond to FARs of 1/1,000, 1/10,000, and 1/100,000, respectively. A higher threshold results in a lower FAR and a lower pass rate. For scenarios with higher security requirements, set a higher threshold
Confidence.description_zh: 转换后的置信度 ，取值范围0.0~100.0，数值越大相似度越高，建议的三个参考阈值为60.48，67.87和72.62，分别对应千分之一，万分之一和十万分之一的误识率，阈值设置越高，误识率越低，通过率也越低，对安全性要求越高的场合，可以设置越高的阈值

EntityId.description_en: The entity ID, which is used to identify the uniqueness of a user, such as a user ID or an employee ID. Each entity can contain multiple face images. The ID can contain letters, digits, and underscores and must be 1 to 64 characters in length
EntityId.description_zh: 实体ID，用来标识用户的唯一性，如用户ID、员工ID等。每个实体可包含多张人脸图片。支持大小写字母、数字、下划线的组合，长度为1~64

ExtraData.description_en: The custom information, which is a string. The information can contain letters, digits, punctuation marks, and Chinese characters and can be up to 512 characters in length
ExtraData.description_zh: 自定义信息（字符串）。支持字母、数字、标点符号和汉字。不超过512个字符

FaceId.description_en: The ID of the face image data, which must be globally unique. The ID can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores and must be 1 to 64 characters in length
FaceId.description_zh: 人脸图片数据ID，需要全局唯一，不可重复。支持小写字母、数字和下划线的组合。长度为1~64

Score.description_en: The face similarity score. Valid values: -1.0 to 1.0. The score is rounded to six decimal places. A higher value indicates a higher similarity. The three recommended reference thresholds are 0.35, 0.45, and 0.6, which correspond to false acceptance rates (FARs) of 1/1,000, 1/10,000, and 1/100,000, respectively. A higher threshold results in a lower FAR and a lower pass rate. For scenarios with higher security requirements, set a higher threshold
Score.description_zh: 人脸的相似度，取值范围-1.0~1.0，取小数点后6位，数值越大相似度越高。建议的三个参考阈值为0.35，0.45和0.6，分别对应千分之一，万分之一和十万分之一的误识率。阈值设置越高，误识率越低，通过率也越低，对安全性要求越高的场合，可以设置越高的阈值

Location.description_en: The coordinate information of the face in the input image
Location.description_zh: 输入图像中的人脸坐标信息

X.description_en: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner

Y.description_en: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner

QualitieScore.description_en: The quality score of the face in the input image
QualitieScore.description_zh: 输入图像中的人脸质量分
